title: Isixuku Esinyamalele
intro: Umi phambi kwemisindo yomphakathi ondaba yawo ibhalwe emagagasini. Le miphefumulo yezwa ubizo, yakhetha ukungalaleli, futhi yabhekana nomphumela owashintsha umhlaba. Bangobani, futhi kwenzekani ngomhlaba wabo?
clues: Sasiphila kudala, kwafika isithunywa kithi sivela phakathi kwethu.
Sakhonza izithixo ezinhlanu futhi senqaba ukuzishiya.
Simhleka usulu isithunywa futhi samsola ngokuthi uyaphambuka.
Safuna ukuthi alethe isijeziso uma ekhuluma iqiniso.
Sibone isibhakabhaka sithela imvula nomhlaba ukhipha imithombo.
Sakhuphukela ezindaweni eziphakeme ukuze sibaleke, kodwa amagagasi asifica.
arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verse: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss. (71:21)
